steps.title: Prepare the Figma plugin
steps.detail: Unify writes the Unify Bridge development plugin into the pack folder.

steps.title: Import the plugin in Figma
steps.detail: In the Figma desktop app, open any design file, then choose Plugins > Development > Import plugin from manifest... and pick this file. If you imported an older Unify Bridge before, remove it first.

steps.title: Connect Figma to Unify
steps.detail: Run Plugins > Development > Unify Bridge, enter the pairing code shown on the Figma toolpack card and press Connect. Keep the plugin window open while agents work.
